notes.title: QUADRA CLASH is now in full development!
notes.notes:
QUADRA CLASH formerly "Sentient" is now back in full development after 7 years

Sentient started out as an idea I had that I couldn't shake, I had no idea how to execute because i had no experience with 3d game engines like Unity or Unreal Engine but watching YouTube videos and Udemy courses I was able to create a mock-up but I quickly realised I was way out of my depth when i started putting the matchmaking / server browsing functions.

Now I have hired the help of a professional game studio and they are going to be bringing my vision to life in a way that I never thought possible

QUADRA CLASH will be a 4 team third person arena shooter with fully simulated ballistics and each team will have 3 players for a total of 12 players per match and each match will be fast paced 10 minute rounds

Here's the first phase preview showcasing the animation system we are using:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2uWcv8VZRI

I will give you guys an update with each phase, Wishlist the game to be notified of playtests in the near future

Thanks a lot guys

~Lee
